approved: Superannuation Supervisory Levy Imposition Amendment Bill 2020
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that would let the Commonwealth recover costs for a broader set of activities it funds through the financial institution supervisory levy framework.
The package would increase the maximum levy amount that can be set under certain Acts to $10 million for the year starting 1 July 2020.
The bills would also allow the method for adjusting that maximum to use the latest available consumer price index figures.
Expands the range of activities for which the Commonwealth can recover costs.
Raises the statutory cap on certain levies to $10 million.
Updates the indexation rule to reference recent CPI data.
Financial institutions subject to the supervisory levy framework.

The Superannuation Supervisory Levy Imposition Amendment Bill 2020 was moved for a second reading to give the Treasurer flexibility to set levies so superannuation industry institutions pay their appropriate share, complementing the APRA Industry Funding Bill 2020.
